mintAuthority.summary: BRZ Ethereum owner and masterMinter are both a 2-of-3 Gnosis Safe (0xaf24/0x2c64, proxy to singleton 0xd9db). Proxy admin (0x478e) is also owned by the same Safe. Reviewed non-Ethereum chain controls include 2-of-3 Safes, a current BSC owner contract (0xd66f), and a current 1-of-2 Solana Token-2022 mint-authority multisig (DzZjd6); legacy BSC/Solana observations remain historical in review evidence only. All controls corroborate Transfero centralized issuance.

review.evidence: Ethereum at block 25294823: owner() = 0xaf24 (2-of-3 GnosisSafe proxy, masterCopy=0xd9db GnosisSafe 1.3.0 singleton). Safe storage: ownerCount=3, threshold=2, nonce=5. Three EOA owners confirmed via linked-list traversal. Modules sentinel = 0x1 (no modules). masterMinter 0x2c64 is an identical 2-of-3 Safe (nonce=15). ProxyAdmin 0x478e owned by same Safe. The legacy BSC owner observation was EOA 0x01455c for superseded 0x71be; current owner() on BRZ 0x0295afd3D7E86068050d64509e515f2Db71b4914 returned 0xd66f8ebda47ec5ec549ecc00fd4bbe102aa4989a, and eth_getCode on that address returned non-empty bytecode, so the current owner is a contract authority. The legacy Solana mint authority ACvei6 was a system-program wallet for superseded FtgGSFADXBtroxq8VCausXRr2of47QBf5AS1NtZCu4GD; current BRZbFNQDcWLfcdHmAkqEVnLHCAWKTRf6eHyEaWdZp3JN is a Token-2022 mint with mintAuthority DzZjd63zf674JCbQcGD7mZ8AXxrAfFE2of5coe2ZV5K1, whose authority account is an initialized 1-of-2 Token-2022 multisig by Solana RPC reads. Polygon and Base owners are also 2-of-3 Safes (threshold=2, ownerCount=3). BRZ is issued by Transfero Swiss AG (Zug); the only dated third-party reserve review located is a ~2020 law-firm report, and current transparency relies on Parsiq blockchain analytics rather than a recurring named accounting-firm attestation, so reconciliation is unknown. Transfero Swiss AG's Swiss oversight is VQF membership, a FINMA-recognised AML self-regulatory organisation that is explicitly not prudential supervision, and no FINMA banking/EMI licence for the BRZ issuer was found, so supervision is none. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: issuer Safes and EOAs directly control minting across chains without an economic cap; current disclosures do not reconcile whole supply and VQF AML membership is not prudential supervision. Reconciliation finding 2026-08-15: Transfero's 2024-03-31 issuer transparency PDF gives a dated reserve and circulation snapshot, but no recurring named third-party reconciliation of BRZ liabilities against BRL reserves was located, so reconciliation remains unknown.
